# LC Bridge (Lead Connector Bridge)

> LC Bridge builds products and custom software for GoHighLevel (GHL / HighLevel): integrations, marketplace apps, SaaS extensions, AI agents, and frontend experiences.

LC Bridge (Lead Connector Bridge) builds products and provides custom development for the GoHighLevel (GHL / HighLevel) CRM ecosystem (also searched as "LeadConnector"). Its former GoHighLevel team members helped design and build APIs used by the developer community. Custom development serves software brands entering the GoHighLevel market and agencies needing substantial integrations, applications, AI agents, or frontend extensions. LC Bridge is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by GoHighLevel or DocuSign.

## Platform names

GoHighLevel is the primary platform name used here. GHL and HighLevel refer to the same platform; readers also search for the spaced spellings Go High Level and High Level. LC Bridge is independent and builds products and services for this platform.

## Custom development

- [GoHighLevel Developers & API Integration Services](https://lcbridge.app/highlevel-development/): GoHighLevel developers for software brands: custom API integrations and middleware, marketplace apps, workflow automation, SaaS and backend extensions, AI agents, and custom JavaScript frontend experiences. The team behind DocuSign Integration and Community Agents. Explore the documented mapping and send flow, and Member Insights. Scope, handover, and support are agreed per engagement. Send a short project brief through the inquiry form; email arun@lcbridge.app is also available.

## Products

- [Google Sheets integration for GoHighLevel by LC Bridge](https://lcbridge.app/google-sheets-integration/): Bring GoHighLevel data into Google Sheets, explore 25 report templates, and review spreadsheet edits before updating matching contacts and opportunities. Early access.
- [Community Agents by LC Bridge](https://lcbridge.app/community-agents/): AI replies for GoHighLevel community teams using supplied knowledge, private previews, and member assessments supported by source conversations. Built for GoHighLevel (GHL), also known as HighLevel. Available now.
- [DocuSign Integration by LC Bridge](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/): Connect DocuSign agreements to GoHighLevel contact data, configured follow-up workflows, and completed-answer sync. Built for GoHighLevel (GHL), also known as HighLevel. Available now.

## Community Agents — installation, pricing and guides

- [Docs and guides](https://lcbridge.app/community-agents/docs/): Browse installation, portal connection, knowledge, response controls, illustrative use cases, Member Insights, demos, and background reading.

- [Pricing](https://lcbridge.app/community-agents/pricing/): $47 USD monthly per GoHighLevel sub-account, including $47 of AI usage per billing period. Usage is metered at 4× provider cost. Included allowance is used first and expires at renewal; additional usage is billed through the appropriate GoHighLevel wallet. Agency resale pricing and taxes may change the final charge.
- [Install in GoHighLevel](https://community-agents.lcbridge.app/oauth/install): Install separately in each sub-account. Launch from GoHighLevel; no separate Community Agents signup or checkout.
- [Setup guide](https://lcbridge.app/community-agents/how-to-add-ai-agent-highlevel-community/): Marketplace installation, member portal, dedicated AI identity, knowledge, preview, and enabled actions.
- [Portal compatibility and GoKollab](https://lcbridge.app/community-agents/gokollab-ai-agents/): Member-facing portal and identity access; a public discovery link alone is insufficient.
- [Knowledge and controls](https://lcbridge.app/community-agents/knowledge-and-controls/): Prepare knowledge, preview replies, and configure allowed actions. Creating posts is manual; reactions are off by default.
- [Member Insights](https://lcbridge.app/community-agents/member-insights/): Review intent/confidence assessments and source conversations. A person decides whether to follow up.

## DocuSign integration — pricing and contact

- [Pricing](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/pricing): Monthly plans: Starter $29 per active sub-account; Agency $249 for up to 250 sub-accounts; Scale $497 for unlimited sub-accounts. Annual totals: $249 per Starter sub-account, $2,390.40 Agency, $4,771.20 Scale. 14-day trial without a card to start; a separate DocuSign account is required.
- [Book a call](https://lcbridge.app/book-a-call/): Book a 30-minute call with Arun, founder of LC Bridge — about any of the integrations.
- [Book a call](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/book-a-call): Book a 30-minute call with the founder about your GoHighLevel setup.
- [Documentation](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/docs/): Setup, triggers, field mapping, and how the white-label layer works.
- [Getting started guide](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/docs/getting-started/): Six-minute video walkthrough plus written steps — connect DocuSign, map a template, send an agreement, track it to signature.
- [Workflows setup guide](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/docs/workflows/): Triggers, actions, stall types, merge fields, switch-on order and step-by-step setup for the six contract workflows.

- [Capabilities and requirements](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/docs/features/): Account prerequisites, configuration, branding and PDF access.
- [Field mapping and answer sync](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/docs/field-mapping/): Prefill mapped contact values and return signer-entered answers after completion.
- [Multiple signers](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/docs/multiple-signers/): Select a contact for each recipient role and preview resolved values.
- [Connection methods](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/how-to-integrate): LC Bridge, configured Zapier integration, and manual processes.
- [Native signing comparison](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/vs-native-signature): GoHighLevel Documents & Contracts and DocuSign support signing; choose by process and account requirements.

## Industry guides

- [DocuSign for Insurance](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/insurance): E-signature workflows for insurance agencies running on GoHighLevel (applications, ACORD-style forms).
- [DocuSign for Real Estate](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/real-estate): E-signature workflows for real estate teams running on GoHighLevel (listing and buyer agreements).

## Guides

- [Why your clients still pay for DocuSign](https://lcbridge.app/blog/why-clients-keep-docusign/): For GoHighLevel agency owners who shipped native Documents & Contracts. Five reasons clients in real estate, insurance and financial services keep DocuSign: the choice belongs to their brokerage or compliance officer, the document leaves the platform, ESIGN 7001(c) consumer disclosure, proving who signed (Ruiz, Espejo, Jones v. Solgen), and years of archives. Sourced, with a disclaimer.
- [The 4 ways a contract stalls](https://lcbridge.app/blog/four-ways-a-contract-stalls/): Sent but not opened, opened but not signed, about to expire, declined. The follow-up each one needs, when to send it, and when to stop.
- [Is a GoHighLevel e-signature legally binding?](https://lcbridge.app/blog/gohighlevel-esignature-legally-binding/): What ESIGN and UETA actually require, the difference between a binding signature and a defensible one (Ruiz v. Moss Bros. vs Espejo), what GoHighLevel's native signature certificate does and does not capture, and the three situations where a dedicated e-signature platform is genuinely warranted.
- [GoHighLevel Integrations: The Complete Guide](https://lcbridge.app/blog/gohighlevel-integrations/): What GoHighLevel integrations are, native vs Zapier, and the full LC Bridge integration directory for the GoHighLevel CRM.
- [The 4 Levels of CRM Integration](https://lcbridge.app/blog/four-levels-of-integration/): A See–Know–Do framework for telling a deep, native integration from a Zapier bolt-on. Covers native integration vs Zapier and integration depth.
- [An AI Agent Can't Chase a Signature It Can't See](https://lcbridge.app/blog/ai-agents-need-deep-integrations/): Why AI-agent readiness (agentic CRM, GoHighLevel AI agent) depends on how deep your CRM integrations go.
